TASK PARTIAL: v31.57 (cw-uc-racks) shipped, but I couldn't take any pictures, so no screen has a critic score yet. The camera script and the critic were both refused for lane b this run. The what's-new card stamp (v31.56, cw-cardp29) had to ship first to clear a stale-stamp STOP.

What v31.57 changes:
- **Racks (14):** it is now one centred 672px column, down from 1316px buttons. Buttons are 48px high. The status and hint lines are 16px in grey instead of 14px.
- **Codex (65):** it is now four centred columns, 1344px at most. The rarity and kills lines are 16px.
- **Stash (04):** the gun key and item wheel plates and their reset buttons go from 12px to 14px. That is below the 16px floor, because I couldn't check wider type fits the tiles without a picture.

I hid two lines under Q8, with the reasons logged in `notes/ui/changes.md`:
- On racks: "the mainframe pays per extraction, every extraction, for as long as it is running". It repeats the tab name, and the status line already shows the pay.
- On the stash: "drag a tile onto another to swap. a raid reads both." It is a how-to sentence, and Q70 says no tutorial prompts.

The new check fails on the old build and passes on the new one. The gate then passed with the seed 4242 fingerprint unchanged (ents 85/374, containers 165/593).

What remains, as noted in `b-31-ui-undercroft.md`:
- Shoot 04, 14 and 65, and run the critic on them.
- Fix the shop leftovers: stat rows, the header currency block and price colours.
- Decide on the welcome pack intro line (02), logging the reason if it goes.
- Still never judged: 03, 05–13, 15–18, 39, 41–44, 66 and 67.

TASK PARTIAL: no critic scores yet for any of the Undercroft screens, because the camera was refused and the changes went in without pictures.
